justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/MethodCall.java and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/MethodCallTest.java. OfInvokedMethod is a compact nested class (lines 1421-1467) with one state field and only constructor/prepare/make/resolve methods; it has a single responsibility: validate that one instrumented parameter is an array and expand it into argument loaders for the invoked method. It is used only by withArgumentArrayElements(int) (lines 440-444), and the tests exercise just this focused behavior, so there is no evidence of insufficient modularization.
